name: Shiraj Momin
headline: Healthcare Technology Leader | Solution Architect | Technical Manager
summary: Experienced healthcare technology professional with expertise in HL7 FHIR, CMS interoperability compliance, Patient Access APIs, Provider Directory APIs, and CMS-0057-F Prior Authorization solutions (CRD, DTR, PAS). Proven track record leading cross-functional teams, defining solution architecture, managing healthcare integrations, and delivering enterprise-scale interoperability platforms for Medicare and commercial payer organizations. Skilled in API strategy, Azure cloud architecture, healthcare data exchange, and technical program leadership.
